Classes

Nabu supports classes, interfaces, enums, and records, following a syntax inspired by Java and Kotlin. ## Classes ```java package foo.bar.shape; public class Rectangle extends AbstractShape implements Shape { } ``` ## Interfaces ```java package foo.bar.shape; public interface Shape { abstract fun points() : List; } ``` Interfaces support `default`, `static`, and `private` methods. ## Enums ```java package foo.bar.shape; public enum Status { ON("On"), OFF("Off"); private final text : String; private Status(final text : String) { this.text = text; } public fun getText() : String { return text; } } ``` The compiler synthesises the `$VALUES`, `values()`, and `valueOf()` members automatically through the `EnumCodeGenerator`. Enum-constant bodies are supported. ## Records ```java package foo.bar.shape; public record IdAndName(id : String, name : String) { } ``` Records support compact constructors, and the `RecordCodeGenerator` expands accessors automatically. The `ACC_RECORD` flag is emitted in the class file.
